row.category: Vertical SaaS (Healthcare, Education, Real Estate, Construction, Field Service)
row.evidence: Benchling's SAML guide says JIT provisioning is off by default and enabled by Benchling Support so users are added when they first log in through SSO; no SCIM endpoint appears in the help centre, the API reference or the Okta and Entra apps (SAML only).
row.notes: New row. Status 'none' by absence (rule 5, confidence medium): automation is SAML JIT only, which rule 2 classes as none (fallbacks.jit true). Pricing is quote-only: the pricing page lists product suites and add-ons with no prices or tiers, so team and SSO plan fields are null. SAML SSO is configured by Tenant Admins (optional or enforced); Microsoft's tutorial requires a 'Benchling single sign-on (SSO) enabled subscription', so SSO may be a contract feature. The REST API v2 can create, bulk-create, update and suspend users and manage organization and team memberships with roles; it has no user delete. API access needs 'Developer Platform' capability set to Full by a Tenant Admin; whether that is plan-gated is not public.

plans.name: Benchling (custom quote)
plans.notes: No public tiers. SAML SSO is documented for tenants; Microsoft's tutorial requires an SSO-enabled subscription (c12).

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint is documented: the help centre (all 655 public articles fetched through its API) never mentions SCIM, the REST API v2 OpenAPI spec has no SCIM paths, and the Okta and Entra catalogue apps are SAML SSO with JIT only. The vendor never says 'no', so available stays null and status is 'none' by absence.

auth.notes: User API keys use HTTP Basic; Benchling Apps use OAuth2 client credentials. base_url pattern taken from examples in the spec (servers: /api/v2 on the tenant host).

endpoints.purpose: Update a user (email, handle, name, isSuspended)
Get a user's activity metadata (last seen)
Create organization membership with a role
Create team membership with a role
Export an object's audit log (async task)

webhooks_user_events.notes: The Events Reference (EventBridge) was checked; no user lifecycle events were found.

audit_log_api.notes: Per-object audit log export as an async task (CSV/PDF); not a tenant-wide event feed.

rate_limits.text: 60 requests per 30 seconds per tenant for all user keys; 300 per 30 seconds per app key; audit export 500 requests per hour.

limitations.text: Benchling has no built-in automatic deactivation of inactive users; the help centre suggests scripting it with the user activity and update endpoints.

okta.notes: Benchling for Enterprise: SAML with JIT provisioning on sign-in; no SCIM provisioning listed.

entra.notes: Gallery app with SAML SSO and JIT only; no Benchling provisioning tutorial in the Entra saas-apps index.

fallbacks.notes: JIT must be switched on by Benchling Support. Admins can also bulk-create users from a CSV spreadsheet in the Tenant Admin Console.
